reforms.description: Quebec budget announced incentives to stimulate R&D as part of fiscal 1987/88 budget measures, alongside low-income relief and increased capital spending.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: R&D incentives are designed to stimulate research and development activity, which enhances innovation capacity and long-term productivity growth.
reforms.status_evidence: Quebec budget on 30th April 1987 announced 'incentives to stimulate R&D' as part of new initiatives enabled by better-than-expected fiscal outcomes.
reforms.importance_rationale: A minor component of a provincial budget announcement with limited detail on scope, design, or funding level. No information on whether this represents a new programme or modification of existing instruments.
reforms.source_quote: Better-than-expected 1986/87 outcome has permitted new initiatives such as low-income relief, incentives to stimulate R&D and increased capital spending.
